notes: The real-Bazel guard tests that run on the toy fixture (fixtures/bazel/core, opened through toy::open) and so belong to the core group, without being `bazel_core_` tests: core/MATRIX.json lists only names with that prefix. Same shape as that file. scripts/bazel-matrix.py plans these tests into the core cell of their Bazel and runner (a core cell is every gating test of the toy fixture), so they run in bazel-compatibility.yml; ci.yml's required row filters on `bazel_core_` and does not run them.

tests lists the Bazel versions each test reported status `ran` on. Both ran on 9.3.2 and 7.7.2 on macOS arm64 (2026-11-12), with no host but the toy registry, which the fixture server plays. The ubuntu cells are where the plan runs them, not where they have run. No Windows cell: nothing has run these tests there.
